distribution_formats.notes: All ten files in the June 2026 release are distributed as ZIP archives via the University of Virginia Dataverse. Individual files below the download size limit may be downloaded directly; the Data Access API is available for programmatic access.
CM4AI output data are packaged with provenance graphs and rich metadata as AI-ready datasets in RO-Crate format using the FAIRSCAPE framework.
